assertion_audit: tests/test_bank_step_geometry.py:26-27 fail if jax.jvp or field.evaluate re-enters the inspected geometry block, guarding the no-per-step-autodiff requirement by source inspection.
tests/test_bank_step_geometry.py:50 fails if the closed-form normal-form rate diverges from topology.saddle_normal_form's independent directional derivative.
tests/test_bank_step_geometry.py:70 fails if no diverted normal-form cell is exercised; :91-93 fail if a sorted edge-cut rate diverges from the topology JVP.

tests/test_bank_step_geometry.py:120-122 fail if ring propagation diverges from current._normal_rings' JVP for the supplied interval rate, but both paths receive the actual interval rate from :88-90, so this assertion alone survives a regression in that rate.

tests/test_bank_step_geometry.py:149-150 fail if a changed booked moment from the closed-form tangent differs from the retained JVP implementation for the selected jet; final-negative.log shows a 1e-3 ring-rate mutation turns this test red.
tests/test_bank_step_geometry.py:192 fails if exact Bell curvature rates diverge from an independently varied field and JVP.

findings.disposition_reason: Lines 87-93 independently check the interval rate, while line 120 checks propagation of a supplied interval rate.
findings.text: The ring-velocity assertion feeds actual_interval from _edge_interval_rate into both the reference JVP and the closed-form ring calculation, so this line alone stays green if that interval rate regresses; disposition: exempted because lines 87-93 independently compare the interval rate with the topology JVP.
